# dokku_acl_app (Data Source)

Manages the dokku-acl access list for a dokku application

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dokku_acl_app" "example" {
  app = "node-js-app"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app` (String) Name of the app

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource's identity address.
- `users` (Set of String) List of users to add, remove, or set on the ACL
